acceptance.bracket_rule: adjacent refinement points where LER(d=3)-LER(d=5) changes from positive to negative
acceptance.significance_rule: Newcombe 95% interval for LER(d=3)-LER(d=5) excludes zero at both refinement points, with opposite signs

model.description: Stim generated surface_code:rotated_memory_z circuit, distances 3/5/7, rounds equal to distance; all four Stim depolarizing hooks set to p; PyMatching MWPM on the decomposed detector error model. This is Stim's standard circuit-level model, not the exact gate-level model of Fowler et al.

notes.exploratory_pilot: A 20k-shot exploratory pilot with a different seed family suggested a crossover near 0.006-0.007. It is not evidence and is excluded from the confirmatory analysis.

citations: Fowler et al., Phys. Rev. A 86, 032324 (2012), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevA.86.032324
Higgott, ACM Transactions on Quantum Computing 3(3), Article 16 (2022), DOI 10.1145/3505637
reference.description: Circuit-level threshold of the rotated surface code under depolarizing noise with minimum-weight perfect matching, reported at approximately 0.57% per step (Fowler et al., PRA 86, 032324, 2012; DOI 10.1103/PhysRevA.86.032324) and approximately 0.7% for the standard circuit-level depolarizing model in the PyMatching documentation (Higgott, ACM TQC 3(3), Article 16, 2022; DOI 10.1145/3505637).
